name: Ragnarok Online Indonesia
note: MMORPG paling legendaris di warnet Indonesia, poring dan Prontera jadi bahasa sehari-hari.
note_en: The most legendary MMORPG in Indonesian warnets; Poring and Prontera became everyday words.

name: Lyto Game Center
note: Portal Lyto tempat beli voucher dan baca patch note game online pertama Indonesia.
note_en: The Lyto portal where you bought vouchers and read patch notes for Indonesia's first online games.

name: GunBound
note: Hitung sudut dan angin buat nembak, mobile Armor jadi rebutan.
note_en: Work out the angle and the wind to shoot; mobile Armor was the one everybody wanted.

name: Point Blank Indonesia
note: FPS online raja warnet akhir 2000-an, cash Gemscool jadi mata uang anak sekolah.
note_en: The online FPS that ruled warnets in the late 2000s; Gemscool cash was schoolkid currency.

name: Audition AyoDance
note: Pencet panah ikut irama sambil cari pacar virtual di AyoDance.
note_en: Hit the arrows to the beat while looking for a virtual sweetheart in AyoDance.

name: Seal Online Indonesia
note: MMORPG imut Lyto yang bersaing dengan Ragnarok di warnet.
note_en: Lyto's cute MMORPG that fought Ragnarok for warnet seats.

name: Lineage II Indonesia
note: MMORPG grafis wah yang bikin PC warnet harus upgrade VGA.
note_en: The MMORPG with graphics so fancy warnet PCs needed a new graphics card.

name: DotA Allstars / Warcraft III
note: Map DotA bikin warnet penuh teriakan 'gank mid!' tiap malam.
note_en: The DotA map filled warnets with shouts of 'gank mid!' every night.

name: Age of Empires II
note: 'Wololo!' — RTS sejarah yang dimainkan LAN di rental komputer.
note_en: 'Wololo!' — the history RTS played over LAN at computer rentals.

name: Winning Eleven / Pro Evolution Soccer
note: Rental PS dan PC penuh turnamen Winning Eleven, Castolo jadi idola.
note_en: PS and PC rentals full of Winning Eleven tournaments; Castolo was everyone's hero.

name: Harvest Moon
note: Bertani dan melamar Popuri di rental PS, game santai paling diingat.
note_en: Farming and proposing to Popuri at the PS rental, the chillest game anyone remembers.

name: Command & Conquer: Red Alert
note: Tanya, Tesla Coil, dan tank Mammoth—RTS LAN paling diingat anak rental.
note_en: Tanya, Tesla Coils and Mammoth tanks — the LAN RTS rental kids remember most.

name: Heroes of Might and Magic III
note: Satu PC dipakai hotseat bergantian sampai warnet tutup.
note_en: One PC shared hotseat-style, turn after turn, until the warnet closed.

name: Nusantara Online
note: MMORPG buatan anak bangsa bertema Majapahit, bangga main game lokal.
note_en: A home-grown MMORPG set in Majapahit times; proud to play a local game.

name: Lost Saga Indonesia
note: Ganti hero pakai gear, duel 'Lost Saga' di warnet tiap pulang sekolah.
note_en: Swap heroes by gear and duel after school at the warnet.

name: Dragon Nest Indonesia
note: Action MMORPG kartun, party nest bareng teman satu baris PC.
note_en: Cartoon action MMORPG; clearing nests with the whole row of PCs.

name: GTA Vice City (port fan)
note: Tommy Vercetti di browser, dari proyek reverse-engineering reVC. Versi DOS Zone dulu kena DMCA Take-Two.
note_en: Tommy Vercetti in the browser, from the reVC reverse-engineering project. The earlier DOS Zone version got a Take-Two DMCA.

name: GTA 2 (port fan)
note: GTA kamera atas yang dulu jalan di PC warnet paling kentang.
note_en: Top-down GTA that once ran on the weakest warnet PCs.

name: Half-Life & CS 1.6 (WebXash)
note: Engine Xash3D di browser. de_dust2, AWP, rush B ala warnet.
note_en: The Xash3D engine in the browser. de_dust2, AWP, rush B warnet style.

name: C&C Generals Zero Hour (port fan)
note: Raja LAN warnet sore hari: China vs GLA, nuke pertama yang menang.
note_en: King of afternoon warnet LAN: China vs GLA, first nuke wins.

name: NFS Underground 2 (port fan)
note: Bayview, nitrous, dan neon bawah mobil. Bisa balapan online bareng teman.
note_en: Bayview, nitrous and underglow neon. You can race friends online.

name: NFS Most Wanted (port fan)
note: BMW M3 GTR, Razor, dan Blacklist. Polisi Rockport masih galak.
note_en: BMW M3 GTR, Razor and the Blacklist. Rockport cops are still mean.

name: Diablo II: LoD (port fan)
note: Baal run sampai billing habis.
note_en: Baal runs until the billing runs out.

name: Halo: Combat Evolved (port fan)
note: Master Chief di tab browser, lengkap dengan kampanye.
note_en: Master Chief in a browser tab, campaign included.

name: Quake III Arena (q3js)
note: Railgun, rocket jump, dan suara Excellent!
note_en: Railgun, rocket jumps and that 'Excellent!' voice.

name: Tekken 5 DR (recomp fan)
note: Kenangan rental PS, sekarang tanpa bayar per jam.
note_en: Memories of the PS rental, now without paying by the hour.

name: Super Mario 64 (port fan)
note: Dari proyek decompile SM64. Port web sejenis dulu sering diturunkan Nintendo.
note_en: From the SM64 decompilation project. Similar web ports were often taken down by Nintendo.

name: Metal Gear Solid (port fan)
note: Snake? Snake?! SNAAAKE!
note_en: Snake? Snake?! SNAAAKE!

name: WipEout (rewrite fan)
note: Balap antigravitasi PS1, ditulis ulang oleh fans.
note_en: PS1 anti-gravity racing, rewritten by fans.

name: LEGO Island (decomp fan)
note: Pepper Roni dan pizza. Hasil decompile komunitas.
note_en: Pepper Roni and pizza. A community decompilation.

name: Heroes of Might and Magic II (fheroes2)
note: Engine fheroes2 di browser. Satu giliran lagi, mas.
note_en: The fheroes2 engine in the browser. Just one more turn, mas.

name: Star Wars: Empire at War (port fan)
note: Strategi galaksi yang dulu bikin PC warnet ngos-ngosan.
note_en: The galactic strategy game that made warnet PCs wheeze.

name: Half-Life 2 (port fan)
note: Port WebGL 2 buatan dua fans. Situsnya sudah tidak bisa dibuka.
note_en: A WebGL 2 port made by two fans. The site no longer opens.

name: GTA Vice City (DOS Zone)
note: Versi browser pertama, diturunkan Take-Two.
note_en: The first browser version, taken down by Take-Two.

name: Red Alert 2 (Chrono Divide, port fan)
note: Engine buatan fans; butuh file ra2.mix dari CD Red Alert 2 kamu sendiri.
note_en: Fan-made engine; needs the ra2.mix file from your own Red Alert 2 CD.

name: Lost Saga (Lost Arena, port fan)
note: Versi browser buatan pemain. Di beberapa ISP Indonesia bisa diblokir.
note_en: Player-made browser version. Some Indonesian ISPs may block it.

name: Project I.G.I. (port fan)
note: Misi stealth David Jones, save cuma di checkpoint.
note_en: David Jones stealth missions, saves only at checkpoints.

name: Pro Evolution Soccer 6 (port fan)
note: PES 6 lewat emulator di browser. Download awalnya besar.
note_en: PES 6 through an in-browser emulator. Large first download.

name: GunZ: The Duel (port fan)
note: K-style, butterfly, dan wall run. Jari pegal semua.
note_en: K-style, butterfly and wall runs. Sore fingers guaranteed.

name: Plants vs. Zombies (remake fan)
note: Tanam peashooter sebelum zombie sampai rumah.
note_en: Plant peashooters before the zombies reach the house.

name: Crash Bash (port fan)
note: Party game Crash 4 pemain. Dulu rebutan stik di rental PS.
note_en: Crash's 4-player party game. We used to fight over the controllers at the PS rental.

name: Resident Evil Outbreak (recomp fan)
note: Zombie Raccoon City versi PS2, dikompilasi ulang ke browser.
note_en: The PS2 Raccoon City zombies, recompiled for the browser.

name: GTA III (port fan)
note: Liberty City dan Claude yang nggak pernah ngomong. Cheat tank wajib.
note_en: Liberty City and Claude, who never says a word. The tank cheat is mandatory.

name: The Simpsons: Hit & Run (port fan)
note: GTA-nya keluarga Simpson. Nyetir mobil Homer keliling Springfield.
note_en: The Simpsons' own GTA. Drive Homer's car around Springfield.

name: Dota 2
note: Bilik penuh teriakan 'report mid!', antre party lima orang sampai subuh.
note_en: Booths full of 'report mid!' shouts, five-stack queues until dawn.

name: Counter-Strike: Global Offensive
note: Penerus CS 1.6 di warnet: buka case, berharap dapat pisau.
note_en: CS 1.6's successor at the warnet: opening cases, hoping for a knife.

name: Tekken 3 (emulator)
note: Paul lawan King di rental PS. Yang kalah gantian bayar sejam.
note_en: Paul vs King at the PS rental. Loser pays for the next hour.

name: Crash Team Racing (emulator)
note: Balapan 4 orang pakai multitap. Satu stik pasti analognya rusak.
note_en: 4-player racing on a multitap. One controller always had a broken stick.

name: Harvest Moon: Back to Nature (emulator)
note: Nikahin Popuri atau Karen? Debat abadi anak rental.
note_en: Marry Popuri or Karen? The eternal PS rental debate.

name: Metal Slug X (emulator)
note: Nyawa habis? Colek temen, lanjut player 2.
note_en: Out of lives? Poke your friend, player 2 joins.

name: Digimon World (emulator)
note: Ngerawat Agumon tiap hari, jadinya Numemon lagi.
note_en: Raised Agumon every day, still got Numemon.

name: Bloody Roar 2 (emulator)
note: Tekan kotak, berubah jadi harimau, langsung combo.
note_en: Press square, turn into a tiger, combo time.
